description: This file defines the 'Rule' class within a validation system, including properties for rule class name, constructor parameters, and an optional message. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties, facilitating rule configuration and management in a validation framework.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Represents a validation rule with configurable class, parameters, and message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Rule object with specified class name, constructor parameters, and optional message.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the rule.

methods.name: setRuleClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of the rule.

methods.name: getRuleConstructorParams
methods.description: Returns the constructor parameters for the rule.

methods.name: setRuleConstructorParams
methods.description: Sets the constructor parameters for the rule.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the custom message associated with the rule, if any.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a custom message for the rule.
